english.note: Catalog concentration minima: Weed Science TOEFL79iBT/550paper or IELTS6.5; Agronomy/Horticulture TOEFL61iBT/500paper or IELTS5.5. Lower scores can entail ESL and restrict assistantships under central policy. Central proficient level is TOEFL79 old/5new, IELTS6.5, DET115 or Essentials9. Confirm concentration test alternatives. Central documented qualifying degree/country exemptions apply.

applicationFee.note: International fee; domestic $60. Central waivers restricted to full-time benefits-eligible employees, US military/veterans and McNair Scholars. Other applicants may inquire with department; program-specific approval is unconfirmed.

requirements.note: PhD requires GPA3.00 on graduate work. Prerequisites set by major professor, graduate coordinator and dean; Weed Science prerequisite/core courses specified by professor and committee. Current catalog does not state GRE or full document list; confirm program and funding requirements. Archive Weed Science lead is a concentration in this degree.

funding.note: Graduate assistantships subject to funds; undergraduate B average or better needed for assistantship eligibility. No universal award guarantee.
